subject: Security

findings.subject: Security
findings.title: Database credential fields are structured directly into tracked appsettings JSON files
findings.recommendation: The current value is only a placeholder, not a live credential, but the config shape invites a real password to be pasted into a tracked file. Remove the Password field from appsettings*.json entirely and source it only from user-secrets (already configured via UserSecretsId) locally and a vault/environment variable in deployed environments.

findings.subject: Security
findings.title: No vault/secret-manager integration is wired up for non-local environments
findings.recommendation: user-secrets covers local development; add an Azure Key Vault (or equivalent) configuration provider for staging/production so real credentials never live in appsettings*.json.

strengths.subject: Security
strengths.title: Errors are logged with class/method context and a correlation ID before being translated to a safe user-facing message

evidence.excerpt: this.Logger.LogError(exInner, "Error occurred in {ClassName}.{MethodName}. CorrelationId: {CorrelationId}", nameof(TestingRepository), nameof(ResetTestingAsync), loggingCorrelation.CorrelationId);

strengths.subject: Security
strengths.title: A dedicated UserException type enforces that only pre-sanitized, user-safe messages ever reach the HTTP response

evidence.excerpt: /// The message should be user-friendly and not contain any sensitive information - including stacktraces, class names, or other internal information.

checkResults.subject: Security
checkResults.reason: No evidence of passwords/tokens/PII being written to log messages; only structured metadata (class, method, correlation id) is logged.

checkResults.subject: Security
checkResults.reason: No user-controlled input is currently written into log messages in the reviewed files.

checkResults.subject: Security
checkResults.reason: A Password config field is committed in appsettings*.json, currently a placeholder but structurally ready to hold a real secret. Downgraded to Warning since no live credential is present.

checkResults.subject: Security
checkResults.reason: No vault/secret-manager provider is configured beyond local user-secrets. Downgraded to Warning consistent with SEC-OP-05.

checkResults.subject: Security
checkResults.reason: This review prioritized auth (Identity & Access), data access (Input & Injection) and error/secrets handling (this subject) first.

notes: Downgraded SEC-OP-05/06 from the checklist's default Error to Warning because the committed value is an obvious placeholder, not a live credential — see recommendation for why the pattern itself still needs to change before real deployment.
